name: Social Worker
description: 816,100 jobs nationally and about 69,100 openings a year — one of the largest openings figures on this site. ⚠⚠⚠ But the specialties people enter the field for pay the least: child, family and school social work is $59,550 and mental health and substance abuse $60,280, while "all other" — largely policy and administration — is $71,900. ⚠⚠ And the clinical licence needs a CSWE-accredited master's plus two years of supervised practice after it.
credentialNote: ⚠⚠ THE LICENCE IS A MASTER'S PLUS TWO YEARS, AND THE TWO YEARS COME AFTER THE DEGREE. Section 491.005, F.S. requires for clinical social work licensure a master's degree in social work from a graduate school accredited by the Council on Social Work Education (or a doctorate), and at least 2 years of clinical social work experience SUBSEQUENT to completion of the graduate degree, supervised by a licensed clinical social worker or the equivalent, plus a theory and practice examination and a law-and-rules component. ⚠ During that period you practise as a REGISTERED INTERN, and in a private practice setting a licensed mental health professional must be on the premises when you provide clinical services. ⚠⚠⚠ THE BSW IS WORTH GRADUATE CREDIT, AND IT EXPIRES. Florida MSW programmes run ADVANCED STANDING tracks for holders of a CSWE-accredited BSW. At Florida State, the state's largest producer, the traditional online MSW is 61 credit hours and advanced standing is 39 — 22 credits, about a third of a master's. ⚠⚠ But FSU requires the BSW to have been earned within the past SEVEN YEARS, with a waiver route that needs social work employment in that period. The extent of advanced standing varies by programme; ask each one. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE ACCREDITATION IS THE WHOLE THING. A bachelor's in psychology, criminal justice, human services or sociology is not a BSW, earns no advanced standing, and is not a route to the LCSW. Verify CSWE accreditation with CSWE.
bodyHtml:
⚠⚠⚠ The specialties people come for are the ones that pay least

Specialty2025 median
✅ Social workers, all other — largely policy, administration, macro practice$71,900
Healthcare social workers$67,880
⚠ Mental health and substance abuse social workers$60,280
⚠⚠ Child, family and school social workers⚠⚠ $59,550
All social workers$61,780

⚠⚠⚠ Child welfare and clinical mental health — the two things most people picture when they say social work — are the bottom two. The best-paid category is the residual one: policy, administration and programme management. Healthcare social work sits comfortably above both clinical specialties.

⚠ Say this plainly rather than around it: the clinical licence takes a master's plus two supervised years, and it leads into the lower-paid half of the field. People do it because the work matters to them, which is a good reason — but it should be a decision made with the table in front of you.

The occupation

Social workers
2025 median$61,780
Employed (2025)816,100
Annual openings✅ 69,100
Growth 2025–356% — faster than average
Entrybachelor's or master's; clinical positions require the master's

⚠⚠ 69,100 openings a year against 816,100 jobs is a replacement rate of about 8.5%. Some of that is growth; a great deal of it is turnover, and in child welfare especially the turnover is the profession's oldest known problem. Read it as easy entry and hard retention rather than as pure opportunity.

⚠⚠⚠ The BSW is worth 22 graduate credits — for seven years

Florida State MSW (the state's largest producer)Credit hours
Traditional (any bachelor's)61
✅ Advanced standing (CSWE-accredited BSW)39

⚠⚠⚠ Twenty-two credit hours — roughly a third of a master's degree — is what a CSWE-accredited BSW is worth. That is the clearest answer on this site to the question of whether the named undergraduate major matters, and it is a bigger discount than anything on the health administration or public health pages.

⚠⚠ And it expires. FSU requires the BSW within the past seven years; beyond that you need a waiver supported by social work employment in that period. So the discount rewards going straight through, and someone returning to study at forty may find it gone.

⚠ The extent of advanced standing varies by programme. Ask each one for its credit total and its recency rule before you choose where to apply.

⚠⚠⚠ SOW and HUS: two prefixes that never meet

Measured across the whole Florida course file:

PrefixUniversitiesState collegesTechnical colleges
SOW social work✅ all 9100
HUS human services⚠⚠ 0172

⚠⚠⚠ Not one Florida public university carries a single HUS course. Human services is a state-college and technical-college subject; the CSWE-accredited degree is a university one. The two prefixes do not connect anywhere in the state.

⚠⚠ What that means for a student: a human services associate degree is a real credential for direct-service work — case aide, residential counsellor, community outreach — and it earns no advanced standing toward an MSW and does not lead to the LCSW. Ten state colleges produce 276 human services credentials a year, and none of those graduates has begun a social work degree.

⚠ If licensure is the goal, get into a CSWE-accredited BSW. SOW2020 and SOW2031 are carried at a handful of state colleges, so the lower-division start exists — but confirm in writing that the credits articulate into a CSWE-accredited bachelor's before you rely on them.

⚠⚠ Where Florida's MSW seats actually are

Nine public universities award the degree, and the master's outnumbers the bachelor's: 1,164 against 712.

InstitutionMSW (2023)
Florida State University431
University of Central Florida193
Florida Atlantic University143
University of South Florida127
University of West Florida120
Florida International University74
University of North Florida28
FAMU / Florida Gulf Coast24 each

⚠ A data note worth knowing if you go looking yourself: Florida's MSW output is split across two federal codes. Only 368 appear under Social Work; the other 796 are filed as Clinical/Medical Social Work, and four institutions record none at all under the obvious code. Counting one code understates the state's MSW production by two-thirds.

Necessary skills

  • Assessment across a whole situation — the person, the family, the money, the housing, the law — which is what distinguishes social work from counselling.
  • Documentation that survives a court. In child welfare your case notes are evidence.
  • Holding a boundary while staying warm. The job is relationships under statutory authority, and both halves are real.
  • Knowing the systems — Medicaid, TANF, Baker Act, dependency court, school district process. Most of the help you give is navigational.
  • Managing a caseload larger than it should be, which is the practical condition of the profession.
  • Deliberate self-management. The turnover statistics above are not abstract, and the people who last plan for that from the start.

Advice

⚠⚠⚠ If you might want the LCSW, do a CSWE-accredited BSW and go straight to the MSW. It is worth 22 credit hours at FSU, and the eligibility window is seven years. Nothing else on this path is that concrete.

⚠⚠ Do not mistake human services for social work. They are different prefixes at different institutions and they do not meet. The human services associate degree is good work and a poor foundation for this licence.

⚠ Look seriously at healthcare social work and at the macro track. They pay $67,880 and $71,900 against $59,550 for child welfare, and hospital and administrative posts tend to have better hours and lower caseloads.

⚠⚠ Plan the two post-master's supervised years deliberately. Find out who will supervise you and whether they are licensed before you take the job — an intern year with no qualified supervisor is two years you cannot count.

And treat the caseload question as the interview question. Ask what the average caseload is, what it is supposed to be, and how long the last three people in the post stayed. The answers tell you more than the salary does.

programs.note: The named route — 9 Florida public institutions, all universities, 712 bachelor's and 1,164 master's a year. ⚠ Read its degrees note on advanced standing, on the seven-year window, and on the SOW/HUS prefix split.

⚠ The closest graduate neighbour and a common dual degree (MSW/MPH). Both sit at universities only and both are master's-weighted. ⚠⚠ The difference: social work ends in a state LICENCE and public health does not.

⚠⚠ Real shared territory — child welfare, juvenile justice, probation and forensic social work — and criminal justice is taught far more widely in Florida. ⚠ But it earns NO advanced standing toward an MSW and does not reach the LCSW. If clinical practice is the goal, only the CSWE route gets there.

⚠ Named because hospital social work and case management are shared work, and healthcare social workers at $67,880 are the best-paid of the clinical social work specialties. ⚠⚠ Also the access comparison: nursing at 78 Florida institutions against social work's 9.

⚠ Where the macro side leads. BLS puts "social workers, all other" — largely policy and programme administration — at $71,900, above both clinical specialties, and this is the degree that formalises the move.

courses.reason: Social Welfare Institutions — 6 institutions, and the intellectual foundation of the degree: how American social provision came to be shaped the way it is.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ Also numbered SOW3213 Social Welfare Policy at some institutions. Register by number.

courses.reason: ⚠ Field Seminar I — 8 institutions, the most widely carried SOW course in Florida. Field education is the signature pedagogy of social work and CSWE accreditation turns on it.
courses.variantNote: ⚠⚠ Placement means Florida Level 2 background screening — start it in week one of the preceding term, not when the field office asks.

courses.reason: Field Experience in Social Welfare — 6 institutions. The placement itself, and the thing employers actually ask about.

⚠ Social Work in Health Care — 6 institutions. Named deliberately: healthcare social workers earn $67,880 against child and family social workers' $59,550, and this is the course that opens that door.
Social Work with Organizations and Communities — 5 institutions. The MACRO half of the profession, and the route toward the best-paid category in the federal data at $71,900.
Child Maltreatment and Child Welfare — 5 institutions. The largest single employment sector for BSW graduates in Florida, and the one with the hardest caseloads.
Introduction to Social Welfare and Social Work — 4 institutions including state colleges. ⚠ Lower division, so it is the cheapest way into the subject for an A.A. student.
courses.variantNote: ⚠⚠ Confirm in writing that it articulates into a CSWE-accredited BSW before relying on it. SOW is carried by 10 state colleges but the accredited degree is a university one.

courses.reason: Careers in Creating Social Change — 4 institutions including Broward, Gulf Coast and Northwest Florida State. A lower-division entry point at a state college.

⚠⚠ Introduction to Human Services — 13 institutions, the most widely carried HUS course. Named as a WARNING as much as a route: this is the state-college human services track, and no Florida public university carries a single HUS course.
courses.variantNote: ⚠⚠⚠ HUS is not SOW. A human services associate degree is a genuine credential for direct-service work, earns NO advanced standing toward an MSW, and does not lead to the LCSW. If licensure is the goal, get onto the SOW side.

courses.reason: Introduction to Psychology — 33 institutions. A universal prerequisite, and the foundation for the clinical half of the degree.
General Sociology — 29 institutions. The other foundation, and closer than psychology to how social work actually frames a case.
Elementary Statistics — 39 institutions. Required for MSW admission almost everywhere, and social work research methods assumes it.
Developmental Psychology — 29 institutions. Human behaviour in the social environment is the MSW's core sequence and this is its undergraduate half.
English Composition I — 39 institutions. In child welfare your case notes are court evidence; writing is a professional competence here, not a general-education box.
Fundamentals of Speech Communication — 16 institutions. Named because MSW admission is interview-based and the job is interviewing.

sources.note: ⚠⚠⚠ Measured over the whole file: SOW is carried by all 9 Florida public universities and 10 state colleges; HUS is carried by 17 state colleges and 2 technical colleges and by NO university. ⚠ The two prefixes never meet, which is the mechanism behind the long-standing warning that human services does not substitute for social work in a CSWE-accredited programme. ⚠ The most widely carried courses are SOW4522 Field Seminar I at 8 institutions and HUS1001 Introduction to Human Services at 13.
